Little by little, things began to change. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Friday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. Also, an advance directive states her wishes.
At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What's more, open your mouth and say "ah".

People around Jack often share different ideas about the health check. Jack thanked Mia for the honest advice. Mia advised Jack to try swimming as a new hobby. Best of all, she answered in clipped tones and hurried back to work.
The health check looked quieter than usual that evening. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Jack will take part in a tennis match in October. Also, the children jumped for joy.
Mia and Jack are preparing a report about the health check. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
